ex.en: The puppy likes to gnaw on old shoes.
Guilt began to gnaw at him after he lied to his friend.
ex.zh: 他對朋友說謊後，罪惡感開始折磨著他。

ex.en: A gnarled old oak stood at the edge of the field.
ex.zh: 一棵多節的老橡樹立在田野的邊緣。

ex.en: His gnarled hands showed how hard he had worked all his life.
ex.zh: 他那雙粗糙扭曲的手顯示他一生工作有多辛苦。

ex.en: In the fairy tale, a gnome lived under the old tree.
ex.zh: 童話故事裡，有個小矮人住在老樹下。

ex.en: The gnome in the story guarded a treasure.
ex.zh: 故事中的地精守護著一份寶藏。

ex.en: She put a red-hatted gnome beside the garden gate.
ex.zh: 她在花園門旁放了一個戴紅帽的小矮人擺飾。

ex.en: The neighbors collect every kind of garden gnome.
ex.zh: 鄰居收集各種花園小矮人擺飾。
